problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 3 cargo shipments through 3 different distribution hubs.

Each shipment must pass through hubs in a specific sequence, represented as pairs (Hub, Handling duration),
where each pair specifies the hub where handling must occur and the time required for processing.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which hubs must be visited.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (Hub B, 3) → (Hub A, 4) → (Hub C, 3)
* S2 follows the route: (Hub A, 2) → (Hub B, 2) → (Hub C, 3)
* S3 follows the route: (Hub A, 9) → (Hub C, 7) → (Hub B, 9)

Each handling operation must run continuously once initiated without interruption,
and each hub can only process one shipment at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all shipments at the hubs
so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
